title: Preserve small matrix weights during int8 export
author: sylvesterkaczmarek

data.description: Adjusts matrix quantizer scale handling so small-magnitude rows are preserved during int8 export by using the row's computed range with a float16 floor and rounding stored scales upward when needed.

novel_contributions: Preserves small matrix weights during int8 export
Uses each row's computed range instead of a fixed minimum scale of 1/127
Floors scale to the smallest positive representable float16 value
Rounds stored scales upward so clipped endpoints remain representable
Applies the same export correction in both PyTorch and MLX
